notes.title: Version update: English version now online
notes.content:
We appreciate all the waiting, Dong-Jin Rice-hime is now officially available in English, you could change your language setting to 「English」to switch your version

※ Cross saving isn’t available between different versions

A promotional sale is starting now until the sixth of March, we are on history low of 40% off! We hope that you will enjoy the localization and now is your best chance to raise your own Rice-hime!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28579562/6230f11b8c6fbe96eb275e22665107a62b292393.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Wrong return
notes.content:
Hello players

We now receive the following error return:
1. Some players can not archive
2.STEAM community function (shift + tab)
3. Training mode on the first 96 days, select the action after the system crashes.

Now the side has been reported to developers and repair.
Once you've made your update, you'll update and notify players.
Thank you.

I apologize for any inconvenience.
